name: Carla Pregel Hoderlein
headline: Strategy & Business Development Manager Iberia @Entrix | UC Berkeley | CDTM | TUM

ca.about:
Carla Pregel Hoderlein studied Electrical Engineering and Information Technology (M.Sc.) focusing on Life Science, Bio- and Neuro-Engineering. She completed a second master's in Management (M.Sc.) at the Technical University Munich to position herself at the intersection of Technology & Business.

During her studies Carla worked as part of the data analysis team for several tech start-ups in the areas of medical technologies, environmental sustainability, and future of work. Furthermore, she explored impact consulting and impact investing.

Her passion for leveraging technology and innovation to create a positive environmental and societal impact led her to join the CDTM Management Team in June 2021. Carla is responsible for the strategic European expansion of CDTM and setting up operations, processes and strategic partnerships for the new location in Spain.

positions.company: Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM) in Valencia
positions.description:
CDTM in Munich is the joint startup hub and digital technology research center of the universities LMU and TU Munich, offering Germany's leading digital technology management education program. In the last 25 years, ~1000 alumni of the program have founded +250 companies which raised more than €6bn with 7 start-ups having reached unicorn status.

• Strategic Planning and Execution: Defined and implemented project plan, including milestones KPIs, aligning departmental strategies with the organization's overall goal. 
• Fundraising: Negotiated and closed a multi-year funding deal, leading investor relations and reporting.
• Strategic Partnerships: Mapped relevant stakeholders and connected with key contacts, forming new relationships with critical partners and negotiating major agreements.
• Communication and PR: Represented CDTM at relevant fairs, panel discussions and events.
• Operations Management: Defined, set up and managing internal processes to support the organization's growth and scalability.
• Hiring: Managed talent pipeline, recruited and onboarded 6 members of the local management team.
• Sales: Closed 5+ collaboration projects with leading companies and startups across different industries, such as Lufthansa Technik.
• Stakeholder Management: Facilitated communication between executive teams across locations as well as the board, preparing and presenting important information to relevant stakeholders.

company.name: Entrix
company.description:
Beyond Trading
We are an energy trader and market leader for trading flexible energy systems in Europe.
Beyond AI-powered trading, Entrix provides innovative solutions for long-term revenue security and grid-supportive battery operation. With our full-service package, we support customers throughout every project phase – from technical design and integration, to continuous optimization, all the way to 24/7 operational support. That includes adapting to changing market conditions and unlocking new revenue opportunities.

With more than 3 GW and 8.5 GWh as well as 70 battery storage assets under contract, Entrix is active in Germany, Poland, Italy, Spain, and Portugal, with offices in Munich, Warsaw, Milan, and Madrid. Entrix has been pioneering battery optimization in Germany by managing one of the country’s first large-scale storage projects – and is now the trusted partner of leading infrastructure players such as Encavis, MEAG (Munich Re), as well as a wide range of local utilities.​
